spans.s:
(दु, ऋ) दुयाहृ r. 1st cl. (याचति-ते)
1 To ask or beg, to solicit, to request.
2 To offer, to tender.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Beggar, mendicant, asking, one who asks or solicits.
E.
याच to ask, aff. ण्वुल्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Beggar, mendicant.
E.
याचन an asker, and कन् added.

f. (-ना)
Asking, begging.
E.
याच to ask, aff. युच्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Asking, soliciting.
E.
याच to ask, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be asked, begged, &c.
E.
याच to ask, अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Asked, begged, solicited.
E.
याच to ask, aff. क्त.

n. (-कं)
A thing borrowed for use.
E.
याचित asked, and कन् added; what is got by solicitation.

mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं)
To be asked, begged, &c.
E.
याच to ask, ण्य aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being asked or solicited.
E.
याच to ask, pass. v., शानच् aff.

f. (-च्ञा)
Asking, begging.
E.
याच to ask, नङ् aff.
